# YHSTBOT - TCDD YHT Telegram Bot

> Telegram bot that searches for TCDD YHT (Turkish high-speed train) tickets, helping users find and book trips between stations.

YHSTBOT lets authorized Telegram users define a trip (origin, destination, date, time) via bot commands or inline queries. Long-running TCDD searches run asynchronously through Celery and Redis, and results are delivered in the Telegram conversation. The bot is deployed with Docker Compose (`bot`, `celery`, `redis` services).
